title: Braised Pork Stew
description: A classic comfort food dish from the Philippines, this braised pork stew is a hearty and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown the pork shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary and sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the pork broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, bay leaves, and black peppercorns.
Return the pork to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender.
Serve hot garnished with chopped green onions, if desired.
